Repairing a crack in a pipe can be achieved through various methods, depending on the type and extent of the damage. For small cracks, epoxy putty or liquid epoxy can be used to fill and seal the crack. For larger cracks, a patch clamp may be necessary, which involves wrapping a metal sleeve around the damaged area to create a watertight seal. In some cases, pipe replacement might be required for extensive damage. It is essential to address pipe issues promptly to prevent further damage or leakage.
